note: 人工双语编稿，仅文本待配音；不预填时间轴。独立业务证据不代表盲区全程健康。

series.title: 指标断档：在盲区中验证业务
series.premise: 09:12起checkout仪表盘停止更新，尚不能判断业务状态。团队用独立探测和入口日志检查业务，同时排查采集链路。
series.outcome: 确认采集器远程写入凭据未随轮换更新，更新后新样本恢复。仅重放有原始时间戳的持久队列数据，其余缺口保持未知；值班接收替代信号及独立采集心跳方案。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 独立于故障链路的信号

recycling.note: 未来候选不计实际复现；实际旧表达只来自p001–p350或本文件此前。

dialogues.title: 指标断档
dialogues.premise: 09:12后仪表盘没有新点，业务状态未确认。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分监控中断和业务故障。

lines.en: Okay, we're flying blind on checkout metrics. Last samples arrived at nine ten. Sorry, nine twelve.
lines.zh: 好，结账指标缺少监控视野。最后样本是九点十分，抱歉，九点十二分。

lines.en: Missing points aren't zero errors. They aren't proof of an outage either.
lines.zh: 没有数据点不等于错误为零，也不能证明业务宕机。

lines.en: I'll take point on this. Just to confirm, service checks run separately, right?
lines.zh: 我来协调。确认一下，业务检查独立运行，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, I'll check actual checkout requests. Maybe only this dashboard is stale.
lines.zh: 是，我会检查实际结账请求。可能只是这个仪表盘陈旧。

lines.en: Check the query path too. Old cached results could hide fresh samples.
lines.zh: 也检查查询路径。旧缓存结果可能遮住新样本。

lines.en: Let me tail the log. I'll inspect collector errors without restarting anything.
lines.zh: 我盯一下日志。先检查采集器错误，不重启任何东西。

lines.en: Save those errors first. We need evidence before changing the pipeline.
lines.zh: 先保存错误。改链路之前需要证据。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for independent checks? A rough estimate is enough.
lines.zh: 那么，独立检查预计多久？大致时间就够。

lines.en: Two minutes for current probes. Historical coverage needs a separate review.
lines.zh: 当前探测两分钟。历史覆盖需要单独核查。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is telemetry loss. Business impact stays unconfirmed for now.
lines.zh: 当前假设是遥测数据丢失，业务影响暂时未确认。

dialogues.title: 确认业务状态
dialogues.premise: 监控中断已立项，独立探测开始返回结果。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清当前有限证据不能覆盖整个缺口。

lines.en: Service status is unknown across the gap. Current checkout probes pass in both zones.
lines.zh: 缺口期间业务状态尚不明确。当前两区结账探测通过。

lines.en: Those probes include payment completion. They're small samples, not every customer request.
lines.zh: 探测包含支付完成，但只是小样本，不是全部客户请求。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, no all-clear yet, right? Keep the uncertainty explicit.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，还不能宣布全部正常，对吧？要明确不确定性。

lines.en: I'm on it for gap boundaries. I'll compare last successful sample times.
lines.zh: 缺口边界我来查。我会比较最后成功样本的时间。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Current tests pass; earlier business health remains unverified.
lines.zh: 我复述一下。当前测试通过，此前业务健康仍未验证。

lines.en: Yes, I'll keep an eye on support reports. Maybe they reveal missed failures.
lines.zh: 是，我会关注支持工单。它们可能揭示漏掉的失败。

lines.en: Use request logs for the earlier interval. Check their completeness before drawing conclusions.
lines.zh: 此前时段用请求日志检查，先确认完整性再下结论。

lines.en: So, our escalation path still covers business failures. Telemetry repair won't replace that.
lines.zh: 那么，业务失败的升级路径仍有效。修遥测不能代替它。

lines.en: Exactly. Keep service response and monitoring repair as separate workstreams.
lines.zh: 没错，业务响应和监控修复分开推进。

lines.en: I'll record both owners in the channel. No green status from missing data.
lines.zh: 我会在频道记录双方负责人，不能因缺数据标绿。

dialogues.title: 建立替代信号
dialogues.premise: 当前探测通过，缺口历史需用独立入口日志补充。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别替代信号的独立性和覆盖限制。

lines.en: Independent signals come from edge logs and probes. Neither uses the broken collector.
lines.zh: 独立信号来自入口日志和探测，都不使用故障采集器。

lines.en: Okay, edge logs include completions and failures. I'll check both, not successes alone.
lines.zh: 好，入口日志包含完成和失败。我会两者都查，不只看成功。

lines.en: Just to confirm, those logs arrive elsewhere, right? Otherwise we'd share the blind spot.
lines.zh: 确认一下，日志送往别处，对吧？否则会共享盲区。

lines.en: Yes, a separate store and delivery path. But verify its latest arrival time.
lines.zh: 是，存储和投递路径独立，但要核对最新到达时间。

lines.en: This temporary workaround should buy us time. Maybe ten minutes for the collector check.
lines.zh: 这个临时方案能争取时间。采集器检查可能要十分钟。

lines.en: The probes cover two checkout journeys. They won't detect every regional problem.
lines.zh: 探测覆盖两条结账流程，不能发现所有区域问题。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on region-specific failures. The edge stream is current so far.
lines.zh: 我会留意区域性失败。入口日志流目前是新的。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for the historical review? Include missing log intervals too.
lines.zh: 那么，历史核查预计多久？也要列出日志缺失时段。

lines.en: About fifteen minutes with completeness checks. Don't equate no complaints with no impact.
lines.zh: 加上完整性检查约十五分钟。没有投诉不等于没有影响。

lines.en: Agreed. I'll label coverage next to each signal. Collector diagnosis comes next.
lines.zh: 同意。我会给每个信号标覆盖范围，接下来查采集器。

dialogues.title: 采集器仍在抓取
dialogues.premise: 替代信号持续运行，开始从采集端定位断档。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分抓取成功和下游写入成功。

lines.en: Okay, scrape freshness looks good locally. Targets still return current samples every minute.
lines.zh: 好，本地抓取新鲜度正常。目标仍每分钟返回当前样本。

lines.en: That proves local collection, not backend delivery. Check remote write responses next.
lines.zh: 这证明本地采集，不证明后端投递。接着检查远程写入响应。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the collector itself runs, right? We shouldn't restart it blindly.
lines.zh: 确认一下，采集器本身在运行，对吧？不要盲目重启。

lines.en: Can we rule that out as target failure? Maybe only for the tested targets.
lines.zh: 能排除目标故障吗？可能只能排除已测目标。

lines.en: Correct. List the targets checked. One healthy target doesn't clear the whole fleet.
lines.zh: 对，列出检查目标。一个健康目标不能代表全部。

lines.en: Let me tail the log again. Write attempts return unauthorized, starting nine twelve.
lines.zh: 我再盯一下日志。九点十二分开始，写入尝试返回未授权。

lines.en: Check credential rotation records. Save response codes, but never paste the token.
lines.zh: 检查凭据轮换记录。保存响应码，但绝不粘贴令牌。

lines.en: So, our working hypothesis is stale credentials. Backend confirmation still matters here.
lines.zh: 那么，当前假设是旧凭据。仍需后端确认。

lines.en: I'll compare backend audit timestamps. That should distinguish rejection from network loss.
lines.zh: 我会比较后端审计时间，这能区分拒绝与网络丢失。

lines.en: I'm on it for configuration versions. No secrets in the incident notes.
lines.zh: 配置版本我来核对。事件记录里不放秘密。

dialogues.title: 后端拒绝写入
dialogues.premise: 本地抓取成功，远程写入未授权，核对后端审计及凭据版本。
dialogues.listeningTask: 判断为何不是存储整体故障。

lines.en: Backend audit confirms write rejection for checkout. Other tenants still ingest current samples.
lines.zh: 后端审计确认结账写入被拒。其他租户仍摄入当前样本。

lines.en: Okay, managed configuration references the old secret. Rotation completed at nine twelve.
lines.zh: 好，统一配置仍引用旧秘密。轮换在九点十二分完成。

lines.en: Just to confirm, this isn't storage-wide failure, right? Keep the scope to checkout.
lines.zh: 确认一下，这不是整个存储故障，对吧？范围保持在结账。

lines.en: Current evidence supports that scope. We haven't audited every tenant's delivery path.
lines.zh: 当前证据支持这个范围，但没审计所有租户的投递路径。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis now has matching timestamps. Maybe review the deployment receipt too.
lines.zh: 当前假设已有对应时间戳，也许还要核对部署回执。

lines.en: The receipt shows the collector missed reload. Update its reference through the approved path.
lines.zh: 回执显示采集器漏了重载。通过批准路径更新引用。

lines.en: I'm on it with the valid secret version. I'll preserve the persistent queue.
lines.zh: 我来用有效秘密版本更新，同时保留持久队列。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for one collector? Verify writes before expanding the change.
lines.zh: 那么，一台采集器预计多久？验证写入后再扩大。

lines.en: Five minutes including a backend query. Local success alone won't be our acceptance gate.
lines.zh: 含后端查询五分钟。本地成功不能单独作为验收关口。

lines.en: I'll maintain independent business checks meanwhile. Pipeline repair doesn't prove customer recovery.
lines.zh: 期间我继续独立业务检查。链路修复不能证明客户恢复。

dialogues.title: 新样本开始抵达
dialogues.premise: 凭据引用已批准更新，先验证单采集器写入。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分恢复新数据和补齐历史。

lines.en: We can resume ingestion on the canary. Backend queries show current checkout samples.
lines.zh: 灰度采集器可以恢复摄入。后端查询能看到当前结账样本。

lines.en: Match sample time and arrival time. Queued old samples can look newly delivered.
lines.zh: 对比样本时间和到达时间。排队旧样本也可能刚送达。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, current timestamps match, right? The old gap remains separate.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，当前时间戳匹配，对吧？旧缺口另算。

lines.en: Yes, fresh timestamps advance each minute. Queue replay hasn't completed yet.
lines.zh: 是，新时间戳每分钟推进。队列重放还没完成。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on independent probes. Maybe another fault could overlap this repair.
lines.zh: 我会留意独立探测。其他故障可能和此次修复重叠。

lines.en: The staged rollout covers remaining collectors next. Each needs backend freshness checks.
lines.zh: 分阶段发布接着覆盖剩余采集器，每台需查后端新鲜度。

lines.en: What's the rollback trigger for this change? A rejected credential means stop expansion.
lines.zh: 这次变更的回退条件是什么？凭据被拒就停止扩大。

lines.en: So, stop and investigate rejected writes. Don't restore a credential that's already revoked.
lines.zh: 那么，写入被拒就停下排查，不恢复已撤销凭据。

lines.en: Let's keep it under observation for ten minutes. Check queue growth as well.
lines.zh: 继续观察十分钟，也检查队列增长。

lines.en: Agreed. I'll record accepted writes per collector. Then we'll reconstruct the timeline.
lines.zh: 同意。我会记录各采集器接受的写入，随后重建时间线。

dialogues.title: 时间戳不能挪到现在
dialogues.premise: 所有采集器新数据恢复，核对排队数据覆盖范围。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清重放必须保持原始时间与后端限制。

lines.en: Preserve original timestamps during replay. Don't stamp historical samples with the current time.
lines.zh: 重放保留原始时间戳，不能把历史样本盖成当前时间。

lines.en: Okay, the durable queue covers nine fifteen onward. Earlier dropped samples aren't recoverable.
lines.zh: 好，持久队列覆盖九点十五分以后。此前丢失样本无法恢复。

lines.en: Just to confirm, backend age limits allow replay, right? Check duplicate handling too.
lines.zh: 确认一下，后端时间限制允许重放，对吧？也查重复处理。

lines.en: Accepted within today's retention policy. Test a small batch before draining everything.
lines.zh: 在今天的保留策略内可接受。清空队列前先测试小批。

lines.en: Let me play that back. We can catch up partly, not recreate every minute.
lines.zh: 我复述一下。只能补上一部分，不能重建每一分钟。

lines.en: Exactly. Report recovered coverage separately from ingestion recovery. They're different milestones.
lines.zh: 没错，恢复的历史覆盖与恢复摄入分开报告，是不同节点。

lines.en: Maybe the accepted batch fills later points. I'll compare source and stored timestamps.
lines.zh: 接受的批次可能补上后半段，我会比较源端与存储时间戳。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for that comparison? Leave unrecoverable minutes explicitly unknown.
lines.zh: 那么，对比预计多久？无法恢复的分钟要明确标未知。

lines.en: Three minutes for this batch. Query through the dashboard path after storage verification.
lines.zh: 本批三分钟。存储验证后再通过仪表盘路径查询。

lines.en: I'll keep business evidence in another timeline. No inferred service health from replay.
lines.zh: 业务证据单放一条时间线，不能由重放推断业务健康。

dialogues.title: 保留未知而非补零
dialogues.premise: 后半段原始样本重放通过，09:12–09:15数据不可恢复。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别缺口对图表和业务结论的影响。

lines.en: Okay, leave the gap visible from nine twelve. Recoverable samples start at nine fifteen.
lines.zh: 好，从九点十二分保留可见缺口。可恢复样本从九点十五分开始。

lines.en: No zero fill or straight interpolation. Either would invent measurements we never collected.
lines.zh: 不补零，也不直接插值，否则会编造从未采到的测量。

lines.en: Just to confirm, reports flag missing coverage, right? They can't claim full-window health.
lines.zh: 确认一下，报告标注缺失覆盖，对吧？不能宣称整窗口健康。

lines.en: Yes, edge logs suggest no broad failure. Maybe small customer issues remain unobserved.
lines.zh: 是，入口日志未显示广泛失败，但小范围客户问题可能未观察到。

lines.en: State log coverage and its limitations. Don't silently substitute it into metric calculations.
lines.zh: 说明日志覆盖及限制，不能默默拿日志替换指标计算。

lines.en: The retention policy protects queue evidence today. We'll save the audit before cleanup.
lines.zh: 今天保留策略保护队列证据。清理前保存审计。

lines.en: Keep an eye on freshness after replay. Historical recovery can mask ongoing lag.
lines.zh: 重放后继续关注新鲜度，历史恢复可能掩盖持续延迟。

lines.en: So, let's park that cleanup until review. First close the loop with the shift.
lines.zh: 那么，清理先留到评审后。先向值班反馈闭环。

lines.en: Include the exact unknown interval. The next operator needs that boundary immediately.
lines.zh: 包含准确未知时段，下个值班人需要马上知道边界。

lines.en: I'll add the customer evidence separately. Current checks pass; the gap stays qualified.
lines.zh: 我会另附客户证据。当前检查通过，缺口结论仍有限制。

dialogues.title: 恢复后仍交代盲区
dialogues.premise: 采集与部分历史恢复，向下一班交代未知范围和替代观测。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住谁接班及何时升级。

lines.en: Okay, we need a stale data warning. The dashboard must show sample age clearly.
lines.zh: 好，需要数据陈旧提示。仪表盘必须清楚显示样本年龄。

lines.en: Use unknown rather than green during gaps. Preserve the missing interval annotation.
lines.zh: 缺口期间用未知，不用绿色。保留缺失时段注释。

lines.en: I'll hand over to the primary on-call. Freshness checks and independent probes stay active.
lines.zh: 我向第一响应值班人交接，新鲜度检查与独立探测继续运行。

lines.en: Who checks the warning delivery? A dashboard banner alone won't wake anyone.
lines.zh: 谁检查提示投递？单独仪表盘横幅叫不醒人。

lines.en: Just to confirm, Raj tests routing today, right? Maybe use a controlled stale sample.
lines.zh: 确认一下，Raj今天测试路由，对吧？可以用受控陈旧样本。

lines.en: The escalation path separates business and telemetry alerts. Probe failures still need immediate review.
lines.zh: 升级路径区分业务与遥测告警。探测失败仍需立即评估。

lines.en: Page the backup if the owner doesn't acknowledge. Put that timeout in the handoff.
lines.zh: 负责人不确认就呼叫后备，把超时时间写入交接。

lines.en: So, five minutes without acknowledgement calls backup. That's our existing rota policy.
lines.zh: 那么，五分钟无确认就呼叫后备，这是现有轮班规则。

lines.en: I'll test an independent notification route. It must survive the collector losing credentials.
lines.zh: 我会测试独立通知路径，它必须能承受采集器凭据失效。

lines.en: I'll attach probe coverage and log limitations. No unsupported promise about the missing interval.
lines.zh: 我附上探测覆盖及日志限制，不对缺失时段作无证据保证。

dialogues.title: 监控链路也要被监控
dialogues.premise: 下一班已接收未知时段和独立信号，确定防复发任务。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分已确认直接原因和流程调查。

lines.en: We need to monitor the monitoring independently. The credential reload missed this collector.
lines.zh: 需要独立监控监控链路。凭据重载漏掉了这台采集器。

lines.en: That's the confirmed delivery failure. Why deployment missed reload still needs investigation.
lines.zh: 这是已确认的投递失败，部署为何漏重载仍需调查。

lines.en: Okay, first action item is reload verification. Managed configuration needs a delivery receipt.
lines.zh: 好，第一个行动项是重载验证。统一配置需要投递回执。

lines.en: Who's picking this up by Friday? Maybe Raj can own the automated check.
lines.zh: 周五前谁来接这项？也许Raj能负责自动检查。

lines.en: I'll own independent heartbeat routing by Thursday. We'll test the same rejection failure.
lines.zh: 我周四前负责独立心跳路由，会测试同样的拒绝写入故障。

lines.en: Yes, I'll verify rollout receipts by Friday. The check belongs in deployment itself.
lines.zh: 是，我周五前验证发布回执。检查应放在部署本身。

lines.en: I'll review queue loss limits tomorrow. We need explicit bounds, not unlimited buffering.
lines.zh: 我明天评审队列丢失限制。需要明确边界，不是无限缓存。

lines.en: So, just to recap, collection is restored. Historical gaps stay documented as unknown.
lines.zh: 那么，小结一下，采集已恢复，历史缺口继续记录为未知。

lines.en: Acceptance includes stale queries and notification delivery. A healthy collector alone isn't enough.
lines.zh: 验收包含陈旧查询及通知投递，只有健康采集器不够。

lines.en: We'll close the loop after that test. Keep independent business checks until acceptance.
lines.zh: 测试后反馈闭环，验收前继续独立业务检查。
